reproduction.error: pydantic.ValidationError: hypotheses.N.experiment.knobs.generate_batch_size Extra inputs are not permitted [type=extra_forbidden]

root_cause: scripts/run_autotrain_continuous.py _matrix() sets base['generate_batch_size'] = 1 for every role='screening' hypothesis (the screening fair-share decode-timeout fix landed in PR #1433), but generate_batch_size was never added to ExperimentKnobs or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_KNOBS in src/slm_training/autoresearch/schemas.py. Every default (role='screening') continuous cycle failed HypothesisMatrix strict validation before an experiment could be locked.

pre_existing_test_regression.note: 5 tests in tests/test_scripts/test_run_autotrain_continuous.py already failed this way on tip of main (34111e6e) before this fix, confirmed by reverting the schema change and re-running.

fix.change: Registered generate_batch_size as ExperimentKnobs field (int | None, ge=1, le=1024, matching the existing batch_size field) and added it to DEFAULT_ALLOWED_KNOBS.

classification.note: The identical arm (control + candidate) that previously could not even lock a manifest now completes with a usable, honestly-gated fixture scoreboard. The model-level outcome of that replayed cycle (c3) is itself non-positive (null primary-metric delta) and is documented separately; this record covers the harness unblock only, per autotrain-iteration-delivery.md's third positive-result criterion.
